results.title: Stripe Expands Engineering Headcount Ahead of IPO Push
results.author: Ingrid Lunden
results.text: Payments giant Stripe is on an aggressive hiring spree, adding over 500 engineers in Q1 2024 as the company prepares for a long-anticipated public offering. The expansion spans London, Dublin and San Francisco.

results.title: Stripe Secures $694m Series I at $65bn Valuation
results.author: Anna Irrera
results.text: Stripe has closed a $694 million funding round valuing the fintech at $65 billion, with proceeds earmarked for employee liquidity and product expansion into new markets including the Middle East.

results.title: New Tools for Platforms and Marketplaces
results.text: Today we are announcing a suite of updates to Stripe Connect, making it easier for platforms to onboard sellers globally and manage compliance requirements automatically.

results.title: Stripe Considers Dual-Class Share Structure
results.author: Julie Verhage
results.text: Bloomberg reports that Stripe's founders are weighing a dual-class structure that would preserve voting control post-IPO.
